functions.name: CompareStrings
documentation: Compares two UTF-8 strings using the options specified on a collator.

arguments.name: left
documentation: The first UTF-8 string passed to collation comparison.

arguments.name: right
documentation: The second UTF-8 string passed to collation comparison.

arguments.name: strength
documentation: The comparison level used by the collator for ordering and equality.

returns.name: result
documentation: The comparison result: less than, equal to, or greater than zero.

functions.name: FindBreaks
documentation: Opens a break iterator for locating text boundaries in the context locale.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text whose boundary offsets are requested.

arguments.name: breakType
documentation: The break iterator kind to use for boundary analysis.

returns.name: byteOffsets
documentation: The native UTF-8 string indices for the text boundaries (returned with 1-based indexes for lua convenience).

functions.name: FindStringMatches
documentation: Creates a string search iterator using a collator and returns every match position.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text scanned by the string search iterator.

arguments.name: pattern
documentation: The UTF-8 pattern whose collation-aware matches are returned.

arguments.name: strength
documentation: The comparison level used by the collator while searching for matches.

returns.name: byteOffsets
documentation: The UTF-8 byte offsets of matches in the text (returned with 1-based indexes for lua convenience).

functions.name: FoldCase
documentation: Case-folds the characters in a string; case-folding is locale-independent and not context-sensitive.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text converted with locale-independent case folding.

returns.name: result
documentation: The case-folded string, which may be longer or shorter than the original.

functions.name: FormatCurrency
documentation: Formats a double as a localized currency value using the provided ISO 4217 currency code.

arguments.name: number
documentation: The double value formatted by the locale currency formatter.

arguments.name: currencyCode
documentation: The 3-letter null-terminated ISO 4217 currency code for currency formatting.

returns.name: result
documentation: The localized currency text produced by the formatter.

functions.name: FormatDate
documentation: Formats Unix time as localized date text using locale date patterns, symbols, style, and optional time zone.

arguments.name: unixTimeSeconds
documentation: The date as seconds since the Unix epoch; this API converts it to milliseconds.

arguments.name: style
documentation: The date format length; None omits the date portion.

arguments.name: timeZone
documentation: The time zone ID applied to the formatter; empty strings keep the formatter default.

returns.name: result
documentation: The formatted date string.

functions.name: FormatDateTime
documentation: Formats Unix time as localized date and time text using locale patterns, symbols, styles, and optional time zone.

arguments.name: unixTimeSeconds
documentation: The date and time as seconds since the Unix epoch; this API converts it to milliseconds.

arguments.name: dateStyle
documentation: The date format length; None omits the date portion.

arguments.name: timeStyle
documentation: The time format length; None omits the time portion.

arguments.name: timeZone
documentation: The time zone ID applied to the formatter; empty strings keep the formatter default.

returns.name: result
documentation: The formatted date and time string.

functions.name: FormatNumber
documentation: Formats a double with locale number formatting using locale symbols, grouping, and the selected non-currency style.

arguments.name: number
documentation: The double value formatted according to the selected number formatter.

arguments.name: style
documentation: The number style to format with; Currency is not accepted here, use FormatCurrency instead.

returns.name: result
documentation: The localized number text produced by the formatter.

functions.name: FormatTime
documentation: Formats Unix time as localized time text using locale time patterns, symbols, style, and optional time zone.

arguments.name: unixTimeSeconds
documentation: The time as seconds since the Unix epoch; this API converts it to milliseconds.

arguments.name: style
documentation: The time format length; None omits the time portion.

arguments.name: timeZone
documentation: The time zone ID applied to the formatter; empty strings keep the formatter default.

returns.name: result
documentation: The formatted time string.

functions.name: GetCurrencyName
documentation: Returns the display name for a currency in the context locale.

arguments.name: currencyCode
documentation: The null-terminated 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

arguments.name: style
documentation: The selector for which kind of currency name to return.

returns.name: result
documentation: The display string for the currency, or the currency code itself if no localized name is available.

functions.name: GetDisplayName
documentation: Gets a display name suitable for the specified locale.

arguments.name: displayLocale
documentation: The locale whose language conventions are used for the display name

returns.name: result
documentation: The displayable name for the locale.

functions.name: GetLocale
documentation: Gets the locale used by this locale context.

returns.name: result
documentation: The locale ID of this locale context.

functions.name: GetSortKey
documentation: Transforms a string into a collation sort key.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text converted into collation sort-key bytes.

arguments.name: strength
documentation: The comparison level used by the collator; lower strengths ignore later-level differences.

returns.name: result
documentation: The sort key bytes excluding the terminating zero byte.

functions.name: Length
documentation: Counts character break boundaries in UTF-8 text.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text counted by character break iteration.

returns.name: result
documentation: The number of character boundaries minus the initial boundary.

functions.name: ParseCurrency
documentation: Parses an entire localized currency string into a double amount and ISO 4217 currency code.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The localized currency text to parse for both amount and ISO 4217 code.

returns.name: result
documentation: The numeric amount and ISO 4217 currency code parsed from the localized currency text.

functions.name: ParseNumber
documentation: Parses an entire localized number string into a double using the selected non-currency number formatter.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The localized numeric text to parse with the selected style.

arguments.name: style
documentation: The number style to parse with; Currency is not accepted here, use ParseCurrency instead.

returns.name: result
documentation: The numeric value parsed from the localized number text.

functions.name: SelectPlural
documentation: Returns the keyword of the first plural rule that applies to a number.

arguments.name: number
documentation: The number for which the plural rule has to be determined.

arguments.name: pluralType
documentation: The plural rule type, cardinal or ordinal.

returns.name: result
documentation: The plural keyword for the rule that applies to the number.

functions.name: SetLocale
documentation: Sets the locale used by this locale context.

arguments.name: locale
documentation: The locale ID used by subsequent locale context calls.

returns.name: success
documentation: True if the locale was updated.

functions.name: ToLower
documentation: Lowercases the characters in a string; casing is locale-dependent and context-sensitive.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text whose characters are lowercased.

returns.name: result
documentation: The lowercased string, which may be longer or shorter than the original.

functions.name: ToTitle
documentation: Titlecases a string using titlecase positions determined by the default Unicode algorithm.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text whose titlecase positions are mapped.

returns.name: result
documentation: The titlecased string, which may be longer or shorter than the original.

functions.name: ToUpper
documentation: Uppercases the characters in a string; casing is locale-dependent and context-sensitive.

arguments.name: text
documentation: The UTF-8 text whose characters are uppercased.

returns.name: result
documentation: The uppercased string, which may be longer or shorter than the original.

functions.name: TransformLocale
documentation: Applies a locale transform to the context locale and returns the transformed locale string.

arguments.name: transform
documentation: The locale transform to apply.

returns.name: result
documentation: The transformed locale string.
